items.q: How quickly can I expect results?
items.a: Paid ads usually show early signals within 2–4 weeks and become stable by month two or three. SEO is a longer game — expect meaningful movement in 3–6 months.

items.q: Do I need to pay for ads separately?
items.a: Yes. Ad spend goes directly to Meta / Google from your own account, so you always stay in control. My fee covers strategy, setup, management and reporting.

items.q: Do you work with small businesses and startups?
items.a: Absolutely. I work with early-stage brands as well as established companies — the plan is always scaled to your budget and goals.

items.q: Can you build my online store too?
items.a: Yes. I set up Shopify and WooCommerce stores with payment, courier and tracking integrations, then market them so launch day isn't silent.
A live dashboard plus a plain-language weekly or monthly report and a review call. You'll always know what we did, what worked and what's next.
